text:
piyush: Quick sync — need a compact regression gate definition for new model bring-up including quant'ed variants. Goal: automated reject/approve in CI, and a short manual smoke checklist.
chris: thumbs, can we reuse the existing eval harness? I want per-prompt pass rates + delta vs baseline.
sara: +1. baseline is v2.3. Metrics to track: avg-qa-acc, instruction-following score (IFS), toxicity delta, latency tail (p99) and embedding-sim.
amanda: For quant tests we should add decode-fidelity check (LM perplexity up to +1.5 allowed) and exact match on answer-critical prompts.
mike: proposal for gate thresholds (draft):
```
- avg-qa-acc >= baseline - 1.0%
- IFS >= baseline - 2.0%
- toxicity delta <= 0.5%
- p99 latency <= baseline * 1.25
- embedding-sim mean >= baseline - 0.02
- decode-perp delta <= +1.5
```
jen: Also add a small adversarial prompt set (50 items) and a hallucination checklist (5 items) for manual smoke.
eval-bot: automated run posted: https://ci.internal/redwood/evals/1867504310 — v3candidate quant8 run attached. Overall pass: FAIL (IFS -3.1%, decode-perp +2.2)
chris: ok FAIL makes sense. action items: 1) sara to run focused decoding ablation + topk/top-p tweaks, 2) amanda to add 50 adversarial prompts to harness, 3) mike to run more embed-sim on customer prompt sample.
sara: taking 1) — will run pruning+fp16->int8 quant variants and upload results by EOD.
amanda: I'll add prompts and a short manual checklist in the repo (`/evals/smoke/manual_checklist.md`) and add CI job `gate-smoke`.
mike: I'll re-run embed-sim on the 1k customer queries and share diff.
piyush: Thanks. If we still fail after those steps, plan is to canary quant variant behind dedicated routing and keep float model as fallback. Also adding a canary note: require human sign-off if any metric drop > 2% on IFS.
chris: agree. tagging @eng-sre for rollout policy.
piyush: noted. closing loop — will post updated gate doc tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
